S.H.I.E.L.D. command centre ? v26

The tactical display now uses actual Natural Earth 1:50m geography, with detailed coastlines and country boundaries, a WGS84 coordinate grid and correctly positioned reference cities.

Select a map region through Tray > HUD appearance > SHIELD map view > World, North America, Europe or Asia-Pacific. The choice is saved and works offline. All geometry is bundled; no map API key is needed.

Reference city markers identify geographic locations. They do not represent the PC's physical location or device tracking. Live assistant, voice and network readouts remain below the map.

Map data: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/ (public domain).
Detailed source URL and SHA-256 are in assets/map-source.txt.
